arguments.summary: A phishing campaign led to a Cobalt Strike beacon execution on WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), attributed to user jsmith@corp.local. The initial access occurred via malicious PowerShell launched from Outlook, leading to lateral movement attempts and C2 communication over HTTPS to a known malicious IP (198.51.100.23). The malware sample (svchost_update.dll, SHA256: a1b2c3d4...) was delivered via encoded command and executed through rundll32 from the Temp directory. Multiple detection systems triggered, including IDS and EDR, but no sandbox analysis was performed due to consensus denial. Containment actions included blocking the C2 IP and resetting user credentials. Eradication involved full endpoint scanning and automated remediation.
